title: paspalum brasiliense
intro: Paspalum brasiliense, commonly known as "Capi", is a type of tropical grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce pain and inflammation, improve wound healing, and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Paspalum brasiliense include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal agent, making it useful for treating a range of health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Paspalum brasiliense include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
